summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Houdini Swap, has integrated its API into Jumper, a multi-chain aggregation app. The integration allows Jumper users to execute private, non-custodial cross-chain swaps and bridges. No financial terms, share transactions, or corporate structure changes are disclosed. This is an operational update regarding a product integration, not a special situation. The filing is a routine report of business development with no impact on shareholders or capital structure. No deal terms apply.
